title: StackOverflowError 与 OutOfMemoryError 的真实触发与捕获
expected_output:
=== StackOverflowError (deep recursion, no tail-call opt on JVM) ===
    StackOverflowError caught : true
    -> stack frames, NOT heap: enlarging -Xmx does not help
=== OutOfMemoryError (array size exceeds VM limit, heap independent) ===
    OutOfMemoryError caught : true
    message : Requested array size exceeds VM limit
    -> 2^31-1 longs is ~16 GiB, rejected before heap is even consulted
=== the JVM survives a caught OutOfMemoryError ===
    main thread still running : true
    caught OOM is recoverable, but the heap state is usually unsafe
